input.source: CMB-S4 public mirror of Planck PR4 lowres products

extraction.fit: simultaneous least-squares real spherical harmonics l=0..3 on all valid HEALPix pixel centres
extraction.reported: C2 and C3 from fitted l=2,3 coefficients
extraction.frequency_policy: report all three channels separately; no best-frequency selection
extraction.foreground_warning: these are frequency maps, not component-separated CMB maps; this is a robustness/held-out diagnostic, not a precision cosmological estimator

verdict_policy.exact_hit: not required from raw frequency maps
verdict_policy.direction: q_data values should be reported without retuning
verdict_policy.promotion: no physical promotion from this frequency-map diagnostic alone

forbidden: add a Galactic mask post hoc
foreground-clean using coefficients chosen after seeing q
